acceleration_formula: a=A*cos(phase), phase=2*pi*0.70*expm1(k*(t-10))/k+phi in core; acceleration envelope outside core
phase_selection: zero net acceleration impulse over 0..270s; no linear drift subtraction
note: Not periodic. Reaching zero speed at 270s leaves a position offset; a separate quintic return ends at 290s. Analyze only 10..250s. No automatic amplitude normalization.
